question_en: List CRs that name spec 38.473 as an affected spec (incoming cross-spec impact).
original_query: MATCH (s:Spec {specNumber: '38.473'})<-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]-(c:CR) RETURN c.tdocNumber, c.summaryOfChange ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10
reference_query: MATCH (s:Spec {specNumber: '38.473'})<-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]-(c:CR) RETURN c.tdocNumber, c.summaryOfChange ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10
completeness_scope: Original RAN3 frozen 19,974-CR identity universe; exact authored tdocNumber DESC LIMIT10. Every one of the 38 possible entrants has its own raw cover and all three roles checked. Not all historical or unobserved external CRs.
graph_preservation: Full original 87,980 node records and 481,498 edges unchanged; all-role/all-spec source parsing of the complete tail derives exactly two additions. Original graph is immutable and still source-disproved.
summary_policy: Original summaryOfChange is still returned and compared independently, but no summary is requested by the English and no source-completeness claim is made for copied optional prose.
integration_gates: Separate full native original-query output with both columns and independent full-column SQL
Requested-field scorer controls and identity/source-corruption controls
Root-approved equal-source input-channel policy, exact pre-call freeze and fresh first-attempt evaluation
